timeline.text: A client's app sat on a database I didn't control the server of — one quota freeze from going dark, same as my own site already had.
So I moved it: a self-hosted Supabase stack on my own machine, behind a tunnel.
Same login, same keys — nobody even noticed the switch.
I also found a security hole: a user could grant themselves admin rights through signup.
Closed it, and dropped one old piece of the stack — freeing 500 megabytes of RAM.
